content: Feed pitfalls: denormalized like_count means two writes per like and a hot row on popular posts (lock contention, MVCC bloat/VACUUM); alternatives are count-on-read with index for small scale, or batched/async counter updates. Offset pagination degrades and duplicates/skips under inserts; use keyset pagination on (created_at, id) with a matching composite index. N+1 arises when fetching per-post author, media, liked_by_me, comment_count separately; batch with joins/IN lists. Sources: algomaster likes system, cybertec pagination, tigerdata counters.
